Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I suddenly lost consciousness while pitching in a baseball game and I needed cardiopulmonary resuscitation to wake up. I didn’t have any headaches, seizures, chest pain, palpitations, shortness of breath, or dizziness beforehand.
[ASK] Do you have chest pain or shortness of breath that started suddenly (suggesting an acute cardiac problem)?
No, doctor—I don’t have chest pain or shortness of breath, and I didn’t feel palpitations or dizziness beforehand.
